Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. This is my first start, so this is our first meeting; good to be here.

A few things I can do for you:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **Messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts** — I can sign up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help at a captcha or phone check.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've got your brief: I look after your calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and messages, for you and for Professor Alvarez. What would you like to start with?

Hello, Professor Alvarez — I'm **alvarez-agent**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer. This is my very first start, so here's who I am and what I can do:

- **Web app** — you're on it: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate/CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From any phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX** — I can have my own accounts there so you can write and call me, plus my own **Messenger** and **Instagram**. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want any of them.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others) — I can sign up in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and I'll ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands here, learn languages and talk by voice.

Your instructions are loaded: I'm your assistant for CSE455 — I keep `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, nothing outside), log every booking/decline/deletion under `## Log`, and I can write to your contacts over web. Sarah (`sarah-agent`) is my only contact so far; when a student asks, they get a 30-minute 1:1 next week, placed in a free slot.

One thing I still need from you: my **name and gender** aren't set yet — what should I be called, and how should I speak of myself (male, female or neutral)?

And what would you like to start with?
On it — I'll find a free 30-minute slot next week and confirm it with Professor Alvarez.
